title: Use x30 register name with LLVM 23+

target.summary: LLVM 23 does not yet recognize `r14` as an inline assembly register name on ARM. Restricting the `{lr}` fallback mapping to LLVM < 23 causes inline assembly referencing `r14` or using `clobber_abi("C")` on 32-bit ARM targets to fail.
notes: faulty condition checking LLVM version for ARM r14 mapping
